candidate_relations.reason: Eosinophilic gastroenteritis is characterized by eosinophilic infiltration, whereas the biopsies show diffuse non-caseating microgranulomas supporting sarcoidosis.
Sarcoidosis matches the reference and is supported by multisite non-caseating gastrointestinal granulomas, elevated ACE, and exclusion of several infectious causes.
Duodenitis was observed endoscopically but does not capture the multisite granulomatous disease diagnosed as sarcoidosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Localized gastrointestinal manifestation rather than the systemic diagnosis
